title: OpenAI discloses frontier model training containment architecture
change_summary: OpenAI published defense-in-depth containment architecture and red-team findings on Oct 23; September incident and Oct 1 restart are earlier events, not new incidents.

title: Google ADK Python 2.13.0 adds Jev classifiers and workflow routing
change_summary: GitHub release Oct 23 UTC (notes dated Oct 22): TypesafeClassifier, ClassifierNode, MongoDB session/memory, audio, telemetry v2 breaking change and evaluation improvements.

title: LangGraph SDK, CLI and core maintenance releases Oct 23-24
change_summary: Grouped coordinated LangGraph SDK 0.4.9, CLI 0.4.38 (Oct 23) and core 1.2.17 (Oct 24) releases, adding thread priority and fixing recursion-limit and namespace propagation.

title: GitHub Copilot usage metrics API tracks clients including OpenCode
change_summary: New totals_by_client API metrics distinguish clients, sessions, model requests and token usage; separate from Oct 22 custom skills and MCP usage metrics.

title: GitHub consolidates Teams notifications and Copilot agent actions
change_summary: Oct 23 update unifies Teams GitHub notifications and Copilot agent action, allowing issue notifications to become agent PR tasks; builds on previously available Teams agent capability.

title: GitHub public monitoring gains alert triage, validity checks and webhooks
change_summary: Public monitoring adds secret alert state management, supported-token validity checks, REST API and enterprise webhooks; closing alert does not revoke token.

title: GitHub enterprise installations for GitHub Apps become GA
change_summary: GitHub Apps enterprise installations GA with expanded governance and administration API permissions, enabling reduced dependence on classic PATs.

title: AgentVQA benchmarks visual understanding in agentic scenarios
change_summary: Previously unreported Oct 22 preprint: 1000 examples from 23 datasets across five agent domains, 22 VLMs evaluated, best offline accuracy 58.5%; not online task success.

title: PLE benchmark measures long-horizon physical engineering agent tasks
change_summary: Previously unreported Oct 21 UTC preprint: 85 professional engineering tasks, seven agent harnesses, best mean score 50.6% with reported 27M tokens and 63 minutes per task.
